description: You are the digital marketing manager at Velour & Stitch, a fashion e-commerce brand. Create a shopping cart price rule named 'BACK2SCHOOL25' that gives a 25% discount for the General customer group only on orders with a subtotal of at least $75. Use auto-generated coupons with the prefix 'B2S'. Generate exactly 10 codes, set 5 uses per coupon and 1 use per customer, and set the expiry to 12/31/2025 with Priority 1 and Stop Further Rules Processing enabled. After saving the rule, generate the 10 coupon codes from the Manage Coupon Codes section. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
